assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature priority is 'Critical' (not Undefined). Impact map documents inheritance in Task Creation Log: '"priority": {"name": "Critical"}' in additional_fields JSON. Also states: 'priority: inherited from Feature TC-9003 (Critical; not "Undefined", so it is propagated)'. Summary-comment.md confirms: 'Priority: Critical (inherited from Feature TC-9003; propagated to all created tasks and epics)'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature fixVersions: 'RHTPA 1.5.0' (non-empty). CLAUDE.md has no '### Jira Field Defaults' section, so fixVersion scope defaults to 'both'. Also states: 'fixVersions: inherited from Feature TC-9003 (RHTPA 1.5.0; Jira Field Defaults section absent from CLAUDE.md, so fixVersion scope defaults to "both" and is propagated to tasks)'. Summary-comment.md confirms: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from Feature TC-9003; propagated to all created tasks and epics. Jira Field Defaults fixVersion scope is absent from CLAUDE.md, so scope defaults to "both" — fixVersions are propagated to tasks.)'.
